title: The Scissors and the Pink Dune Flowers
youtube_title: The Scissors and the Pink Dune Flowers | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Nature lets us visit its color without asking us to carry the color away.
summary: Amina brings round-tipped scissors to cut pink dune flowers for the cottage table, sees the bees feeding, and draws the blossoms instead so they stay blooming.
